title:
ALITA 22NFT
Sunset Noir.
lede: A solo mobile editing office. Preserved desk and lift bed. Tail power. Six-panel solar. Two laundry studies.

columns.text: Confirmed user direction
Rear desk, drawer pedestal, lift bed and garage remain. Keep the factory kitchen and forward couch where practical. Dry bath and cab-over sleeping are retained.

RV5 + two B4810 packs at the tail underbody; six Callsun 275 W panels parallel; two Victron driving chargers; onboard generator with automatic start; Furrion ducted 18K heat pump; Starlink; vented Splendide with A/B placement.
Quiet work and sleep, camera/luggage storage and economical improvements remain the purpose.
Three evidence levels
Confirmed Published manufacturer value for the exact named component or OEM year. This does not verify fit to a selected VIN.
Credible Dealer/historical guide or unresolved published data, including the unusually high panel mass.
ESTIMATE Reconstructed dimensions, positions, routes, costs/energy scenarios and modeling assumptions. Every physical installation coordinate in this book is in this category.
Exact production year, VIN and actual OCCC remain unknown. Current OEM 2027 22NF is the dimensional reference; dealer 22NFT alias is retained in project naming.

blocks.text: AGS priority remains solar → battery → generator backup, with quiet-hour inhibit and a reserve set from actual loads. Driving alternator charging is separate; stationary chassis engine auto-start is excluded.

Δrear = mass × distance aft of front axle / 178 in
Δfront = mass − Δrear

For a component behind the rear axle, rear load rises by more than its mass and the front axle unloads. The estimate is static, longitudinal and level-ground; it does not model suspension, corner loads, braking or mounting stresses.

The ~45.5 × 37 × 9.5 in envelope has barely enough bare-envelope space; manufacturer cooling, orientation and connector clearances are unknown. Modeled 10.2 in clearance / 5.9° departure angle is a concern to measure, not a qualified design.

23.5 W × 22.625 D × 33–33.375 H in; 148 lb. Provide ≥280 lb solid level floor support, proper anchoring and 1 in front/back case clearances (0 side minimum).
Dedicated 120 V 15 A circuit; rated 11 A / 1,300 W. Vented drying requires a dedicated 4 in exterior metal duct and permitted duct length/bends, plus ≥8 sq in enclosure makeup air.
Drain standpipe ≥1.25 in ID, capacity ≥7 gpm. Standpipe top 25–34 in above appliance bottom; hose outlet/air break per installation manual. Do not seal hose into an unvented drain.
Proposed plumbing, not verified
Individual shutoff tees at kitchen hot/cold supplies; protected serviceable hose routes to laundry bay; independent trapped standpipe draining to a verified kitchen gray branch.
Rendered routes are topology. Underfloor penetrations, branch slope/venting, freeze protection, trap cleanout, tank response and exterior dryer outlet need a measured installation plan.
The appliance door-open envelope is ~40.5 in from the datasheet diagram, marked Credible for access planning; verify actual appliance and loading posture.

rows.text: 2.98 kWh: editing 0.70; refrigerator 0.80; camera/laptop 0.40; lights 0.20; Starlink 8 h 0.68; pumps/fans 0.20
~0.20 h mathematical minimum; practical run scheduling longer
~8.6 h/day at 3.2 kW AC × 90% delivered energy; ~8–11 h working range

blocks.text: Harvest above is conditional on an approved input arrangement accepting the full 1,650 W. One published 50 A input at the panel’s 21.29 V operating point has an approximate 1.06 kW ceiling. Actual clipped kWh requires an irradiance profile and verified controller limits; these full-nameplate harvest values are not validated available energy.

These are explicit scenarios, not a measured Furrion duty cycle or a cooling-load calculation. Insulation, windshield solar gain, envelope leakage, humidity, occupancy and setpoint are unknown. 18K capacity and indoor comfort at 100°F must be tested.
1,650 W solar does not support continuous extreme-weather cooling in this stress case. Shade, hotter panels, flat mounting and obstruction can reduce harvest; bifacial gain is not counted.

title: Quiet nights, laundry and recharge.

columns.text: Battery budget

10.24 kWh nominal × 80% SOC window × 90% inverter efficiency = 7.37 kWh estimated AC energy. Mild night: 8 h × 0.55 kW + 0.60 kWh base = 5.00 kWh. Hot night: 8 h × 1.20 kW + 0.60 = 10.20 kWh; eight hours is not supported in this scenario.

With 2.3 kW net battery recharge during generator operation, restoring 8.19 kWh DC across the assumed SOC window takes ~3.6 hours before taper/thermal penalties. Charger setting must leave capacity for simultaneous HVAC/other loads.
Scheduling laundry

Placeholder wash/dry cycle: 2–4 kWh and 12–20 gal water, both ESTIMATE, not published cycle performance. This can consume ~27–54% of modeled usable AC battery energy and a substantial fraction of the 35 gal fresh/30 gal gray capacity.
Run laundry during surplus solar, driving/generator charge or shore power after measured cycle data. Pairing 1,300 W laundry with HVAC and RV5 charging requires load budgeting.
AGS thresholds and quiet hours must be set from measured demand and reserve, with verified generator interface. A mathematical minimum runtime is not a reliable operational schedule.

columns.text: Solar / roof
Location / reason. Six landscape Callsun panels, three ahead and three aft of the existing central HVAC band. All six parallel is the requested topology.
Size / mass. 68.35 × 30.16 × 1.38 in each; website 65.65 lb each. 393.9 lb total; mounting allowance 30 lb ESTIMATE.

Clearance / conflicts. Modeled 1 in row gaps and 11.33 in panel-edge side margins; these are not manufacturer service setbacks. Roof attachment pattern, service walkway, shading and real fixtures unknown.

Service / risks. Roof screws, glands and combiner reachable only after measured service plan. Six-panel common branch 77.52 A conflicts with published 50 A input. Split 3+3 parallel banks remain an alternative pending independent-input and PV2 alternator-use confirmation.
Tail batteries
Location / reason. Both B4810 packs below the rear floor next to the spare. Horizontal side-by-side study retains all cabin storage.
Size / mass. Each 23.94 × 14.96 × 5.71 in / 101.4 lb. Pair 10.24 kWh / 202.8 lb.

Clearance / conflicts. Orientation/terminal access unapproved. Two packs side by side plus inverter fit only as bare envelopes inside a very tight 45.5 × 37 × 9.5 in enclosure ESTIMATE. No production clearance established.

Service / risks. Removable gasketed service lid, engineered frame tray, restraints and disconnect. Road salt, water, impact, low temperature, suspension travel and spare removal require an engineered installation.
RV5 hub
Location / reason. At tail alongside the side-by-side batteries within the protected compartment, out of cabin sight.
Size / mass. 17.72 × 19.69 × 6.30 in / 30.86 lb; 5 kW AC inverter.

Clearance / conflicts. Dry cooling air and service connector space are mandatory design gates; no outdoor rating is assumed for RV5. Modeled enclosure mass 40 lb + 15 lb tail cables/protection ESTIMATE.
Service / risks. Hub face/lid must be reachable with spare installed. PV current limit, generator transfer/grounding, external charger/BMS and automatic generator SOC/start interface unresolved.
Alternator / Orion ×2
Location / reason. Forward dry electrical compartment near driver-side chassis connection, keeping the long low-current 48 V route aft. Driving charge only.
Size / mass. Provisional 12/48-8 Smart: each 5.12 × 7.32 × 3.15 in / 3.97 lb. Combined 720 W at 40°C, 860 W at 25°C.
Clearance / conflicts. Ford CCP, wire sizes, fuses, alternator margin, temperature derating and cooling spacing require current-year upfitter guide. No engine auto-start.
Service / risks. Up-to-60 V output must NOT go to 50 V-max RV5 PV. Candidate external battery charge path shown pending written Bluetti permission and appropriate BMS controls.
Generator / AGS
Location / reason. Retain OEM onboard generator. AC route to RV5 input/transfer architecture; optional verified start controller in distribution bay.
Size / mass. OEM published 4 kW generator. Actual model, fuel, dimensions, mass and interface UNKNOWN. Existing generator is part of base coach.
Clearance / conflicts. Confirm start power, generator/exhaust access, voltage/frequency, rated output, neutral/ground and shore/generator switching. No replacement generator assumed.
Service / risks. AGS must support SOC thresholds, quiet-hour inhibits and verified safe start/stop control. No claim that RV5 already supports the required generator start connector.
18K ducted heat pump
Location / reason. Replace stock rooftop unit at the factory opening, retain existing ceiling distribution where compatible.
Size / mass. 29.5 × 29 × 14.5 in / 77.16 lb gross. Correct ducted heat-pump SKU FACR18HEDA-BL-AM.
Clearance / conflicts. Exact roof opening, duct/ADB/thermostat/controller, return air, condensate and coil service clearance unknown. Factory removed A/C mass not supplied.

Service / risks. AC-powered via RV5. No promise of continuous solar cooling in Las Vegas. Lift-bed/control-head clearance and production versus prototype layout must be checked through full bed travel.
Laundry A / bath side
Location / reason. Proposed appliance bay in estimated bath-adjacent storage, aft of the dry bath on the driver side. Keep shower and toilet footprint.
Size / mass. 23.5 × 22.625 × 33.375 in / 148 lb, support/lines allowance 15 lb ESTIMATE.

Clearance / conflicts. About 3.69 sq ft appliance footprint lost from storage, not bath floor. A modeled bay is ~25.5 × 25.5 in (4.52 sq ft). Open door/loading depth ~40.5 in; aisle and bath-door conflict unresolved.

Service / risks. Potentially 2–3 m supply/drain route across protected floor cavity to galley branch, and 0.3–0.8 m 4 in exterior vent (ESTIMATE). Dedicated trapped standpipe, 7 gpm branch capacity and service pull-out required.
Laundry B / rear garage
Location / reason. Passenger-side garage opposite preserved rear desk and drawers. Factory rear bed shown raised.
Size / mass. Same 148 lb machine + 15 lb support/lines allowance. Larger rear-axle increment than A.
Clearance / conflicts. Same ~4.52 sq ft proposed bay; displaces case/scooter staging. Full loading aisle, chair motion, rear hatch path and lowered-bed swept volume unresolved.

Service / risks. Approx 2–4 m supply/drain path toward galley and 0.3–0.8 m exterior dryer vent ESTIMATE. Vibration/noise closer to editing desk and sleeping bed; anchor to engineered floor, retain service isolation.
Starlink / roof
Location / reason. Provisional Standard 4X low mount in the central equipment band beside A/C, router/PSU inside pantry/electrical service zone.
Size / mass. Antenna 23.4 × 15.07 × 1.56 in; system ~10.98 lb incl 15 m cable/router/PSU, plus 2 lb mount ESTIMATE.
Clearance / conflicts. 110° field of view, actual mount dimensions, A/C shielding, cable length and watertight gland require a roof survey. Variant not finalized by user.
Service / risks. 75–100 W average published. Cable bend radius, router cooling/service and safe cable entry required. No roof drilling approved by visualization.
Preserved workspace / towing
Location / reason. Factory desk/drawers/lift bed, kitchen/front couch, dry bath and cab-over sleeping functions retained. Generic hatchback attached visually.
Size / mass. Coach 26 ft /178 in WB per current 2027 OEM; width 91 in reconstructed. Hatchback scenario 2,500 lb ESTIMATE.
Clearance / conflicts. All furniture/cabinet/window positions are reconstructed. Lift-bed and gear loading paths remain a walkthrough gate. Vehicle graphics/badges deliberately omitted.

Service / risks. Actual OCCC and scaled axle loads must govern. At GVWR 11,000 lb, 13,500 lb GCWR leaves only 2,500 lb for the entire towed combination. Exact Abarth manual, baseplate, hitch and brakes required.

blocks.text: Retain the requested architecture while verifying compatibility before purchasing or adding controllers. The render includes only the selected equipment and explicit protection/service allowances.

No invented installed-cost total. Manufacturer promotions, tax/freight and labor change; final budget needs a dated exact-parts quote after walkthrough. This avoids presenting a low but incomplete equipment-only figure as a build cost.

D01 Latest user instruction supersedes couch placement: RV5 and both B4810 packs are modeled at the tail, beneath the floor, beside a reconstructed spare. This increases rear axle load and unloading of the front axle; retain the decision while documenting feasibility gates.

D02 Six 275 W Callsun panels replace 1,200 W / six 200 W proposals. All six are parallel. Two provisional junction/protection boxes are represented. A split 3+3 input allocation is only a compatibility alternative, not a change to the requested six-parallel topology; electrical connection to independent RV5 inputs is NOT approved. One six-panel 77.52 A branch exceeds a published 50 A input.

D03 Current OEM 2027 22NF geometry uses 26 ft / 178 in WB. Exact production VIN/year is unknown. Earlier 22 ft 2 in / 156 in concept geometry was rejected because it conflicts with current manufacturer dimensions. 91 in width and 220 in usable roof remain estimates.

D04 Keep factory rear desk, drawers, kitchen, couch and lift bed. No under-desk laundry. A is adjacent to bath in a replaced storage bay; B is opposite desk on kitchen/fridge side of rear garage. Both are mutually exclusive modeled options; neither physical fit is verified.

D05 Select the ducted heat-pump Furrion FACR18HEDA-BL-AM to implement user selection. It is an AC appliance; earlier DC CountryMod concept is superseded. Factory removed A/C mass and duct adaptation remain unknown.

D06 Orion-Tr Smart 12/48-8 selected provisionally because Ford source is 12 V and house bus is 48 V. The current official table lists this model. Direct B4810 charge acceptance/BMS approval is unresolved; 48 V Orion output is incompatible with a 50 V-max RV5 PV input.

D07 Starlink Standard 4X used for visual dimensions because no variant was specified. Low mount, cable glands and sky view are estimated. No manufacturer logos or wordmarks appear in coach/appliance geometry.

D08 Saved personal style recovered: black #000, bone #f3f1ec, muted #e6e3dd, gold #cdb96a; Jost and IBM Plex Mono, editorial hairlines and small radii. Warm wood/charcoal materials implement Sunset Noir. Saved red status color deliberately excluded under latest instruction.

D09 All cabinet/window/fixture/chassis locations, roof edge/service clearances, spare position, enclosure and laundry plumbing paths are ESTIMATE. Renders are design visualization with actual component envelopes, not surveyed installation drawings.
D10 Callsun website mass 65.65 lb per panel used conservatively, not quietly replaced with a lighter plausible value. Unresolved net/shipping mass is a high-priority payload gate.

D11 AGS remains a generator requirement with solar → battery → generator priority. No stationary chassis engine auto-start. Diagram shows pending generator controller and RV5 SOC integration rather than asserting a working start interface.

D12 Prior +294 rear / −91 front represents approximately the 202.8 lb battery pair at an 80 in tail lever. It omits RV5, enclosure, brackets and wiring. Current model axle results use explicitly estimated longitudinal centers; actual axle scales govern.

D13 No complete 22NFT project room document was discoverable in accessible connected records. Maintain docs/PROJECT-22NFT.md as an explicit current project record with book links and walkthrough items; original inaccessible room remains an outstanding synchronization item.

D14 Pip bpy failed because workspace external DNS is blocked. Installed Blender 5.2.2 initially crashed during Metal detection on a headless machine. A local copied executable with a null-safe strstr interpose shim enabled native CPU Cycles. No installed app was modified. Scripts include portable fallback instructions.

D15 Render inspection exposed a reconstructed-frame interference in an early stacked tail study. Packs were changed to horizontal side-by-side in a 45.5 × 37 × 9.5 in enclosure envelope, beneath the rail. This is a modeling correction, not installation approval; bare-envelope margins remain too tight to establish cooling/service fit.

D16 Initial Cycles exterior showed boolean/bevel sidewall artifacts. Mesh normals and modifier application order were corrected and the image rerendered. Sky API renamed in Blender 5.2 was adapted; a failed viewer bundle was retried with a local Three.js alias. Direct image inspection tools timed out; local JPEG bytes were emitted successfully for visual review.

Confirm Orion-Tr Smart exact model, thermal spacing, forward dry mounting/service access and Bluetti permission for external 48 V charging/BMS integration. Never route up-to-60 V Orion output into a 50 V-max PV input.

Identify generator make/model/fuel/start/stop connector and rated usable output. Confirm safe AGS controller/relay interface, SOC trigger, quiet-hour inhibit and battery-sufficient start supply; no stationary chassis-engine auto-start.

Confirm RV5 transfer/neutral-ground behavior and generator AC input compatibility, 12 V house distribution and HVAC/laundry branch capacities.

Verify heat-pump ducted SKU, thermostat/ADB/controller compatibility, return opening, condensate path, roof loading and lift-bed/head interference.

Measure actual 100°F cooling demand, indoor temperature/humidity and compressor draw over time; sustained cooling is not established by solar wattage alone.

Log editing, refrigerator, Starlink and overnight loads to set real SOC reserve and AGS thresholds.
1 / Survey the production unit

Record VIN/year and actual OCCC/axle weights. Tape the roof into a fixture grid; confirm panel net mass. Measure the tail/spare/hitch volume at loaded ride height. Template both laundry bays through the entire bed and door sweep.
2 / Close interface gates

Obtain supported RV5 PV/BMS/Orion and generator/AGS wiring. Confirm ducted HVAC adapters and appliance plumbing/vent requirements. Establish an engineered frame mount and protected cooling/service enclosure.
3 / Revise the model from measurements

Edit source inputs rather than eyeballing renders. Recalculate load centers and net additions after removals. Test HVAC, Starlink and laundry cycle energy/water/noise before setting quiet-hour SOC policy.
Reproducibility

Source .blend, GLB, Python scripts, native PNG/JPEG renders, annotation scripts, specs and calculation JSON are included. CPU Cycles samples are budgeted to complete every view; reviewed defects are logged in QA.md.
